name: kinlace
description: Kinlace Parent Recap: a nightly Brief of your kids' school and club news, in your language

plugins.name: parent-recap
plugins.description: Every evening, summarizes your kids' school mail, Wilma, WhatsApp parent groups and MyClub into a Brief in your language sent to your inbox, with optional Weekend Picks. Supports macOS and Windows 11 (x64). WhatsApp, direct Google Calendar updates, and in-chat settings changes are Mac-only.
